posts.text: The failing New York Times wrote about the “settling of a sexual harassment suit brought years ago by a waitress at President Trump’s golf club in Bedminster, N.J.” What they fail to say is that it did not involve President Trump, a rather important omission. FAKE NEWS!!!

posts.text: The New York Times incorrectly reported that “Mr. Trump called into the premier of a C-Span show, APPARENTLY WITHOUT NOTICE.” This is WRONG. The Times knew this, but lied, in order to demean - But this is the least of their lies!

posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: A Huge Victory against Fake News BBC, a terrible abuser of the truth, just handed down by highly respected District Court Judge, Jeffrey T. Kuntz, of the Southern District of Florida.
